title: Wanting to play ragtime, heard on phonographs and at dances
summary: His mother did not mind jazz; Basie says he wanted ragtime from the phonographs and dance bands, not from Mowchow, who taught reading.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
